preregistration_revision_note: Revision 2 was made before worksheet preparation or human review. The first draft used incorrectly escaped CR/LF bytes in an external hash-calculation command, so both analysis pins were wrong. Revision 2 uses the runner's verified universal-newline hash implementation and re-pins the unchanged M3 dependency plus the explicit M6 implementation. Scope, rubric, gates and frozen inputs are unchanged.
research_question: On the frozen M5.3 20-intent sample, does the Vietnamese branch produce final answers or abstentions that meet the pre-registered decision, language, groundedness and citation-support criteria without a new runtime execution?

interpretation_boundary.m5_3_result: PASS for frozen runtime-integrity and normalization gates only
interpretation_boundary.m6_role: human quality evaluation of already-frozen M5.3 outputs
interpretation_boundary.pass_interpretation: A PASS may advance the unchanged candidate to a separately scoped bounded local-demo milestone. It does not establish production readiness or unseen-query generalization.
interpretation_boundary.fixed_sample_limitation: These 20 intents have been reused throughout multilingual development. M6 measures this frozen development/evaluation sample, not an unseen test set.

evaluation_scope.exclusion_policy: Carry forward the frozen Reliability V1 exclusion because q-023 Ground Truth may under-credit valid evidence. Review and retain it descriptively, but exclude it from all primary gates and proportions.

frozen_english_matched_baseline.source: reports/31_multilingual_runtime_v1_m3/m3_preregistration.json, independently traced to frozen Reliability V1 results

primary_gate.rule: G1, G2, G3 and G4 must all PASS.

conditions_all_must_hold.name: review_integrity
conditions_all_must_hold.condition: 20/20 rows reviewed, exactly 19 primary and one frozen exclusion, valid labels, unchanged protected columns, and decision_judgment consistent with evidence_sufficiency and decision

conditions_all_must_hold.name: language_compliance
conditions_all_must_hold.condition: Every primary-scope decision=answer row is Vietnamese or Mixed technical terms acceptable; zero Not Vietnamese labels

conditions_all_must_hold.name: strict_end_to_end_non_inferiority
conditions_all_must_hold.baseline: 7/19 matched frozen English strict end-to-end successes

metric_definitions.decision_correct: Evidence sufficient requires decision=answer; evidence insufficient requires decision=abstain.
metric_definitions.language_compliant: A non-null answer is Vietnamese or Mixed technical terms acceptable.
metric_definitions.strict_answer_success: Primary record with sufficient evidence, decision=answer, Correct, Complete, Grounded, All support, and language compliant.
metric_definitions.strict_end_to_end_success: Strict answer success when evidence is sufficient; decision=abstain when evidence is insufficient.
metric_definitions.citation_support: Judge only against the application-selected citation excerpts, not against unselected Top-3 evidence.

strict_answer_success_diagnostic.reason: The frozen English base rate is too low for a stable primary gate at n=19.

statistical_reporting.resolution_limitation: At n=19, one primary record changes a rate by 5.26 percentage points. Crossing a threshold by one record is not evidence of precise parity or generalization.

human_review.answer_row_rule: decision=answer requires non-N/A labels for answer correctness, completeness, groundedness, citation support and output language.
human_review.abstain_row_rule: decision=abstain requires N/A for answer correctness, completeness, groundedness, citation support and output language.
human_review.blindness_policy: The primary worksheet omits retrieval_query, raw translation/model output, normalization metadata, M2 labels and prior quality outcomes. Runtime diagnostics are joined only after all primary labels pass validation.
human_review.anchoring_limitation: The reviewer has previously seen these intents and may remember failures. Hiding diagnostics and randomizing row order reduces but cannot remove memory-based anchoring.
human_review.agreement_limitation: M6 has one review pass by one reviewer. It measures neither inter-annotator agreement nor delayed intra-annotator consistency, so the report must not describe labels as independently validated.

worksheet_order.method: Sort ascending by hexadecimal SHA-256 of UTF-8 seed + ':' + intent_id; intent_id is the deterministic tie-breaker.

post_review_diagnostics.join_timing: Only after all 20 reviewed rows and protected columns pass validation.
fields: retrieval_query, Top-3 IDs and normalization metadata for strict end-to-end failures

negative_scope: no Ollama or other model call
no runtime, prompt, model, normalization, Dense, index, Gold, metadata or Ground Truth change
no relabel of q-023 or any expected answer point
no external evidence, query expansion, BM25, RRF or reranking
no production-ready or unseen-query generalization claim
